changes.title: Democratic senator talks Trump's Russian diesel deal

changes.title: Democrat Chris Pappas says "we're taking nothing for granted" in N.H. race
changes.summary: Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas, who's running to represent New Hampshire in the Senate, said that "we're taking nothing for granted" as Election Day approaches, amid a "tough race" in the Granite State.

changes.title: New Hampshire Democrat Cinde Warmington says Canada trade war is "crushing the people of our state"
changes.summary: Democratic gubernatorial nominee Cinde Warmington, who won her New Hampshire primary on Tuesday, joins "The Takeout" to discuss the midterm races.

changes.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze New Hampshire primary election results

changes.summary: New Hampshire primary voters are choosing candidates for Congress, governor and the 424-seat state Legislature on Tuesday, and incumbents aren't the only familiar names on the ballot.

changes.title: New Hampshire primaries test Trump and the left
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s endorsement will be put to the test once again Tuesday in New Hampshire’s primaries, where liberal Democrats are also looking to cap an ascendant primary season with additional victories.
